storage: Keep in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place; soaked pearls keep 1 day in a closed box in the fridge (dish 40).
looksLike: Small, hard, opaque white balls 2–3 mm across (medium size); they swell and turn translucent when soaked.
howToPick: Choose uniform, clean white medium pearls with no musty smell, powder or discolouration; very small pearls turn mushy and very large ones need longer soaking (dish 40 tip). Tamil Nadu advocacy groups have alleged chemical adulteration (allegations, not findings), so buy from a known brand.
shelfLife: Several months in a dry airtight container (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 75 g raw per serving (about ½ cup)
